title: Knowledge base
subtitle: Documents the agent may cite. Answers stay inside this material and name the fragment they used.

create.title: Add a document
create.name: Title
create.contentPlaceholder: Paste the policy text. It is split into overlapping fragments so a sentence on a boundary stays retrievable.
create.hint: Text is chunked into ~600 characters with 80 characters of overlap. Existing documents are not replaced.

list.title: Documents
list.empty: No documents yet. Add the first one so answers can cite it.

detail.title: Knowledge document
detail.notFound: This document is unavailable in this workspace.
detail.empty: No original text is stored for this document.

delete.label: Delete
delete.confirm: Delete “{{title}}” and all of its fragments? Answers will stop citing it.

edit.title: Edit document
edit.description: Edit the title or text. Saving rebuilds the vectors for this document.
edit.saved: Document updated. Its new index is active.
edit.conflict: This document has changed. Close the editor to load the latest version before editing again.
edit.failed: Could not update the document. Try again.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage the knowledge base.
errors.failed: The knowledge base did not accept that change.
errors.embeddingIncomplete: The selected knowledge embedding model is missing connection settings or an API key.
errors.embeddingInvalid: The selected knowledge embedding model is invalid. Check its protocol, API URL, model name, and vector dimension.
errors.embeddingAuthentication: The embedding provider rejected the API request. Check whether the API key is valid and belongs to the endpoint’s region.
errors.vectorStore: The Redis vector store is unavailable. Check its address in AI Services and make sure Redis has the search module enabled.

notConfigured: The embedding service is unavailable. An administrator can check the selected model, API key, and vector store under AI Configuration.
